wsjHeadlines.title: Wall Street Worries Bank of America’s Problems Will Linger
wsjHeadlines.description: Weak earnings coupled with a fine has analysts pressing executives about whether there is more pain to come.

wsjHeadlines.description: Investment banking revenues are up, and wealth-management divisions are winning new AI millionaires as clients.

wsjHeadlines.description: An investigation by a Trump regulator detailed examples of businesses and individuals getting shut out by the nation’s biggest banks.

wsjHeadlines.title: Fund Managers Are Bullish—Watch Out
wsjHeadlines.description: Plus, investors await inflation data

wsjHeadlines.title: Stubborn Sellers Are the Last Thing Propping Up Home Prices
wsjHeadlines.description: Mortgage rates above 7% might not be enough to crack home values if owners hold the line.

wsjHeadlines.title: Gulf Hurricane Not Big Enough to Reset Insurance Market
wsjHeadlines.description: Capital flowing into insurance might actually be weakening the sector.

wsjHeadlines.title: AI Agents Are a Threat to Travel Businesses. Airbnb Could Still Be a Winner.
wsjHeadlines.description: For the lodging platform’s stock to thrive in the age of bots, it has to turn repeat customers into loyal ones.

wsjHeadlines.title: Home Sellers Are Starting to Blink on Prices. That’s Bad for Builders.
wsjHeadlines.description: Competition for buyers is heating up, which will force companies like Lennar and KB home to beef up incentives.

wsjHeadlines.title: Nvidia’s Subtle Change to How It Counts Cash Flow Has Big Implications for Buybacks
wsjHeadlines.description: The chip maker quietly signaled a new way of thinking about the competing demands of capital returns and building its AI ecosystem.

wsjHeadlines.title: Choosing the Right Bond Strategy for Today’s High-Yield World
wsjHeadlines.description: Before chasing higher rates, bond buyers have to figure out what type of investor they actually are.

wsjHeadlines.title: Fairfax Financial Buying Majority Stake in India’s IDBI Bank
wsjHeadlines.description: Canada’s Fairfax Financial is positioning itself in India’s fast-growing financial services industry with the acquisition of a majority stake in IDBI Bank for about $5.43 billion.

wsjHeadlines.title: Bank of America Settlement Charge Hits Profit, Morgan Stanley Profit Climbs
wsjHeadlines.description: Bank of America reported a lower third-quarter profit, mostly tied to a regulatory settlement charge, while Morgan Stanley’s overall profit and revenue climbed.

wsjHeadlines.title: Bank of America to Pay $1.2 Billion to Settle Violations of Money Laundering, Sanctions Laws
wsjHeadlines.description: The Treasury Department and regulators say bank missed $5 billion of suspicious activity.

wsjHeadlines.description: Find insight on major Gulf stocks, JP Morgan Chase, Goldman Sachs and more in the latest Market Talks covering financial services.

wsjHeadlines.title: U.S. Stocks Fall On Hot Inflation Report, AI Sell-Off
wsjHeadlines.description: U.S. stocks slid as deepening inflation bolstered the case for another rate increase this year.

wsjHeadlines.title: Stocks Turn Lower as AI, Tech Shares Slump
wsjHeadlines.description: U.S. stocks were lower, with the Nasdaq bearing the brunt of the declines, as a hotter-than-expected September inflation report put a dampener on the mood in markets .

wsjHeadlines.title: Berkshire Hathaway Builds 4% Stake in Bending Spoons
wsjHeadlines.description: The Milan-based company said Berkshire made a fresh investment of $330 million after plowing $600 million into its July IPO.

wsjHeadlines.title: Third-Quarter Earnings Season Faces Challenge of Sky-High Expectations
wsjHeadlines.description: Positive earnings momentum will continue in the third quarter but companies faced the challenge of beating sky-high investor expectations, UniCredit said.

wsjHeadlines.title: Failure of Australia’s Largest IPO in Decades Sends Tremors Through AI Trade
wsjHeadlines.description: High interest rates and political uncertainty have data-center startups and other tech companies rethinking their go-public timing.

wsjHeadlines.title: U.S. Stocks Tick Down as Bank Earnings Don’t Excite
wsjHeadlines.description: It was a sluggish day for U.S. stock movements, as early bank earnings failed to quash broader concerns about inflation and Fed rate hikes.

wsjHeadlines.title: Bank Earnings Look Strong, But Markets Shrug
wsjHeadlines.description: Plus, memory stocks fall, and private equity is facing a reckoning.

wsjHeadlines.title: Opinion | America Needs More Capital
wsjHeadlines.description: Economic growth will solve the debt problem and keep us ahead in AI. That will require new investors.

wsjHeadlines.title: Opinion | Modernize and Reform the Recycling System
wsjHeadlines.description: The answer isn’t to abandon it but rather to fix it through private-sector innovation, policy standardization and targeted materials recovery.

wsjHeadlines.title: European Indexes Slide as Tech, Industrials Drop
wsjHeadlines.description: European stock indexes slid at open with technology and industrial stocks falling.

wsjHeadlines.title: Opinion | Washington Needs the Tax-Reform Spirit of ’86
wsjHeadlines.description: Close loopholes that cost trillions in federal revenue and encourage the wealthy to game the system.

wsjHeadlines.title: Opinion | Covid, Climate and the ‘Consensus Trap’
wsjHeadlines.description: Scientists are as prone as anyone else to groupthink, and stifling dissent often produces disaster.

wsjHeadlines.title: Opinion | When Can You Sue if Your 401(k) Underperforms?
wsjHeadlines.description: Investors sought to hedge risk and got lower returns. Now the Supreme Court will hear their case.

wsjHeadlines.title: U.S. Natural Gas Futures Fall Ahead of Weekly Storage Data
wsjHeadlines.description: U.S. natural gas futures gave back most of yesterday’s gains with production recovering and market focus turning to the EIA’s weekly storage report due on Thursday.

wsjHeadlines.title: Precious Metals Sink As U.S. CPI Numbers Give Dollar A Lift
wsjHeadlines.description: Gold and silver futures settled lower after U.S. consumer price inflation for September landed above estimates, increasing market expectations for a Fed interest-rate rise this month and pushing the U.S. dollar higher.

wsjHeadlines.title: Morgan Stanley Raises Dated Brent Forecast on High Shipping Costs
wsjHeadlines.description: Oil prices were higher. MS now projects Dated Brent at $105 in the fourth quarter and at $100 in the first quarter of 2027, citing tanker freight costs.

wsjHeadlines.title: Oil Futures Settle Mixed as Diesel’s Rise Helps Lift WTI
wsjHeadlines.description: Crude futures end the session mixed, with Brent down and WTI edging up.

wsjHeadlines.title: U.S. Natural Gas Futures Gain on Storage Views
wsjHeadlines.description: U.S. natural gas futures rose as solid LNG feedgas flows and some short-term weather-driven demand limit end-of-season storage estimates.

wsjHeadlines.title: Dollar Strengthens on Hot Inflation Data, Higher Treasury Yields
wsjHeadlines.description: The U.S. dollar strengthened as higher-than-expected September inflation sent bond yields up amid expectations of an increase in interest rates.

wsjHeadlines.title: Euro Struggles to Regain Momentum, Falls to 16-Month Low Vs Sterling
wsjHeadlines.description: The euro fell and was struggling for momentum as it dropped to its lowest since June 2025 against sterling.
